newsitem.title: USA: Delaware jury set to deliberate in Parretti case.
newsitem.headline: Delaware jury set to deliberate in Parretti case.

text.p: The jury in the trial of former Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer Inc chief Giancarlo Parretti on charges of perjury and evidence tampering will begin deliberations later on Tuesday after closing arguments by lawyers.

Parretti was indicted on the charges in 1992 by a Delaware grand jury after the bank that financed his 1990 buyout of MGM, Credit Lyonnais, accused him of altering a document to appear as if it had been faxed to him.

The document had been submitted as evidence in the 1991 legal battle in which the Delaware Chancery Court approved the ouster of Parretti as head of the movie studio and granted control of MGM to the bank.
